dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: Should I go to Mualani's store to check out the new surfboards...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And can't you go have a look?

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: I can... and can't.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: If you asked me whether I wanted to go, the answer would be an unequivocal yes.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: But if you were to ask my wallet whether it could afford the trip, the answer would be "probably not."

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: And if you were to ask my house, it would argue that it could make better use of the Mora by building yet another storage extension.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: I... I should respect their opinions too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seeya.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: Take care. I'm going to dwell on my dilemma some more...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you consider your "work" again?

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: Ah, that's right! Once I enter Mualani's shop, I wouldn't be able to leave. That would mean I would also no longer be able to work. That's a perfectly valid point.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: ...But if we were to look at it that way, then in the interest of fairness, shouldn't I also pose the question to my other hobbies?

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: I've got a lot of hobbies, you know. Surfing, kayaking, swimming, water polo...

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: If I were to also count their votes, then the final vote would probably be very different.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: Hmm... Guess I'll do a more comprehensive count of the votes later. This will be a problem for future me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you out on patrol?

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: That's correct. Reconstruction work within the tribe has pretty much all been handed out, so the chief assigned me to patrol the area nearby instead.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: According to the Pyro Archon, we gave the Abyss a thorough thrashing this time, so there shouldn't be any more major disturbances in the short term. But they are cunning enemies, so we must stay vigilant.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: So hobbies and whatnot will just have to be set aside for now. As the bearer of an Ancient Name, I'm sure Miss Mualani must have plenty to keep her busy too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll get a chance some day.

dialogues.speaker: Tairona
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're right!
